response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptionally talented senior software engineer with 20 years of diverse development experience and impressive technical depth. However, he has a critical disqualification: the resume shows zero evidence of people management experience despite the job explicitly requiring 2+ years. The role is described as a "full-time people-leadership role" with core responsibilities including conducting one-on-ones and performance feedback. While Bogdan has some developer tools/infrastructure background and demonstrates strong technical leadership potential through teaching and community contributions, these do not substitute for actual people management experience. He would be an excellent fit for a senior engineering or principal IC role but is currently unqualified for this manager position.
strengths: Exceptional technical depth with 20 years across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems; strong system design and architecture capabilities across multiple language ecosystems
Relevant infrastructure and tooling experience including CI/CD setup, DevOps infrastructure, and current work with MCP code generators and developer tooling frameworks
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts and develop others through workshops, courses, and active open-source community contributions showing knowledge-sharing initiative
concerns: Critical gap: Zero evidence of people management experience—no mention of managing direct reports, conducting performance reviews, or formal team leadership despite job requiring 2+ years

Developer tools background is inconsistent and not clearly 3+ years focused; DevOps work at Altom was part of a 2-year role, current MCP work is less than 1 year, with other tools work being side projects

Staff titles reflect senior individual contributor status with no clear evidence of formal technical leadership responsibilities like team mentoring, architecture guidance, or organizational influence
